title: CmdPal: fix two hangs in top-level queries

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The current revision retains the command ownership and cached-property fixes. Recent rows are now unwrapped through `recent.Source.Safe` before selecting the host-owned top-level command view-model, and the lifecycle tests construct the corresponding `InProcObject<IListItem>`. Borrowed commands are not reinitialized; replacement removes the old handler before subscribing again. Default context-item titles use the cached command name rather than fetching it again from the extension.

The new source delta was inspected together with the existing ownership and cleanup paths. The lifecycle tests were inspected, not independently executed on this revision. The reported Mouse Without Borders build failure is separate context, not a demonstrated defect in these changed CmdPal files. This assessment does not certify runtime hang resolution or a passing product build.

No additional code change is requested by this focused accumulated assessment. This is a qualified summary, not an unconditional approval.
